entities.summary: František Zach, also known as Franjo Zah, was a Czech and Serbian military leader and military theorist. He is best known for his service to the Principality of Serbia, being the first acting General and Chief of the Serbian General Staff from 1876 to 1877.

entities.summary: František Zach, also known as Franjo Zah, was a Czech and Serbian military leader and military theorist. He is best known for his service to the Principality of Serbia, being the first acting General and Chief of the Serbian General Staff from 1876 to 1877.
